title: Salinity-corrected soil moisture probe
abstract: A probe corrects its moisture estimate for salinity.
description: A capacitance measurement at two excitation frequencies gives a salinity estimate, and the moisture estimate is corrected with the salinity estimate using a lookup table for each soil type.

claims.text: A soil moisture probe configured to measure capacitance at two excitation frequencies, estimate salinity from the ratio of the capacitance values, and correct the moisture estimate with the salinity estimate using a lookup table per soil type.
